# Data

## Inclusion/exclusion criteria

```{r}
#| label: tbl-flow
#| tbl-cap: Information for flowchart
#| tbl-pos: "H"

default_kable(flow)
```

NOTE!!!!!! Depending on if use 120 or 7 day blanking period also need to exclude patients with $\le$ 7/120 days follow-up (outtime_hyperk7/outtime_hyperk120).

## Population defintion

2009-2021

- See @tbl-vars for definitions for Heart failure, MI and hypertension. 
- CKD. RRT = 1 in SNR any time or eGFR < 60. eGFR will be calculated according to the 2012 formula. Kreatinin values < 25, > 1500 as well as kreatinin values collected in in-patient care will be excluded. 

The patient enters the potential population at the first date when any of the above is fulfilled. Baseline is if/when the patient has a recorded potassium > 5.5. Potassium values > 10 will be excluded. Only potassium values in the outpatient setting or on the day of hospital admission will be considered. If a patient has > 1 potassium > 5.5 during follow-up a random value is selected. 

## Outcome defintion

The outcome is defined as the first potassium > 5.5 after baseline. Potassium values > 10 will be excluded. Only potassium values in the outpatient setting or on the day of hospital admission will be considered. 

Censoring occurs at 2021-12-31, migration from Stockholm, death or at 1 year. 

### Blanking period

Two blanking periods will be applied: 

1. 120 days

2. 7 days

## Covariable definitions

All covariables are defined at baseline (so not at the end of the blanking period), with the exception of the medications. 

NOTE!!!! Some variables need to be created from the existing ones (for example anemia needs to be created from sos_com_anemiadiag, lab_hb and sos_lm_anemia)
